object.medium: Smartphone: aluminium and black polycarbonate body, 3.5-inch glass multi-touch display
object.description: Apple's first iPhone, unveiled by Steve Jobs at Macworld on 9 January 2007 and released that June, replaced the keypad of earlier phones with a 3.5-inch multi-touch screen and a single home button. Combining a phone, an iPod and an internet browser in one slab of aluminium and glass, it set the pattern that nearly every smartphone has followed since. This exhibit is a CC BY artist's model of the handset, not a scan of a particular example.
facts: Announced on 9 January 2007 and released in the United States on 29 June 2007 at $499 for the 4 GB model and $599 for 8 GB.
It measures 115 x 61 x 11.6 mm and weighs 135 g, with a 3.5-inch 320x480 display and 128 MB of memory.
About 6.1 million units were sold before it was discontinued on 11 July 2008 in favour of the iPhone 3G.
